<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Lean v4.30.0-rc2 Mathlib periphery module InterfaceBits importing core Becoming.RelSpan under [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext] with zero native_decide, zero private/opaque source declarations, zero n=3,4 brute-force search, and environment-wide audit of all 156 module constants.
- Confusability R includes equality reflexively and assumes symmetric pairwise confusability rather than an arbitrary channel output hypergraph.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The module establishes only 30 <= alpha(C7^3) <= 35 locally; published packing alpha(C7^3) = 33 and chi(C7^3) >= 11 stand external in the literature.
- c7Sq_chiCC2_le proves chiCC2(C7^2) <= 4 via a concrete witness; 3-class UNSAT evidence belongs to external probe records rather than Lean.
- Triangle-free classes give list size <= 2 when common outputs form triangles; pairwise confusability permits 3 distinct outputs, so the converse needs every relevant triangle to admit a common output (Rule 2).
- **Counterexample:** c7Sq_chi_eq drops chi(C7^2) = 5 strictly below 3^2 = 9 while c7Sq_chiCC2_le achieves 4 CC2 classes; c2_collapse_clique exhibits 2^n distinguishable finite representatives inside one C2 collapsed fiber.
